subject: Renewal + expansion: updated billing contact, PO and NET60 request
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: procurement@acmecloud.com, olivia.mendez@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion: updated billing contact, PO and NET60 request

Hi Olivia / Acme procurement team,

We're starting the renewal conversation for your Redwood contract (renewal window opens 2027-03-01). Per our usage review, it looks like you're ready to add two additional Dedicated nodes for peak capacity — happy to include that in the renewal. Before I produce an updated invoice/contract amendment, can you confirm:

- Desired contract term (12 vs 24 months)
- Whether procurement will issue a PO and the PO number format you need
- Updated billing contact and email for invoices
- If you require NET60 instead of your current NET30 terms (you mentioned this on the last call)

If it helps, I can draft an amendment and provisional invoice to attach to your PO.

Thanks — I'll loop finance once we have PO and billing contact.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_Price_Summary_Q1-2027.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]

From: Olivia Mendez <olivia.mendez@acmecloud.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, jared.liu@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: updated billing contact, PO and NET60 request

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the heads-up. We're planning on a 24-month renewal and will add the two Dedicated nodes. Procurement will issue a PO — format will be ACME-PO-YYYY-####; I'll confirm the exact number next week.

Billing contact has changed: please send invoices to:
Accounting Operations <acct-ops@acmecloud.com>
And CC: Jared Liu <jared.liu@acmecloud.com> on payment questions.

We do need NET60 terms for all renewals moving forward. Also, procurement requires a completed W-9 for vendor setup (we're US-based). Can you provide our finance team with an invoice and a W-9 for Redwood?

I can attach our internal PO once it's created.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director, Cloud Platform — Acme Cloud
[Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: olivia.mendez@acmecloud.com, procurement@acmecloud.com

Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: updated billing contact, PO and NET60 request

Hi Olivia — great, 24 months + 2 Dedicated nodes noted and NET60 approved for this renewal (pending final procurement PO). I've attached:

- Provisional invoice reflecting upgrade + 24-month term
- Draft amendment that will be appended to the Master Services Agreement (MSA)
- Redwood W-9 for vendor setup

Marissa from Finance is on copy to confirm the NET60 and finalize the invoice numbering once you send the PO.

Next steps for you: share the PO when ready and confirm the ACME-PO-YYYY-#### number. Once we receive the PO we'll issue the signed amendment and final invoice.

Regards,
Lauren
[Attachments: Redwood_Provisional_Invoice_20270211.pdf (PDF, 34KB); Redwood_Amendment_Dedicated_Quote.pdf (PDF, 16KB); Redwood_W9.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details. Finance confirms we can accept NET60 for this customer and will set the billing contact to acct-ops@acmecloud.com once vendor setup is complete. A couple of notes:

- Please attach the issued PO (ACME-PO-2027-0587 or similar) when available. We need a copy to post to the invoice.
- Tax forms: we received your note about vendor setup — attaching our W-9 here for your records.
- Invoice numbering: final invoice will be INV-RW-2027-ACME-0587 (we'll align # with your PO).

If procurement needs a different remittance address or specific invoice fields, paste the required text here and we'll include it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
